card.name: Words introducing a list of items
card.fires_on: The word right before a list or enumerated point is introduced, most often "following" in "contraindicated in the following conditions". It also fires on "thing", "points", "one" and "Criteria" in similar lead-in spots.

modes.label: Contraindication lead-in
modes.description: "following" after "contraindicated in the" or "under the", just before a bulleted list of conditions.
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Ganirelix acetate injection is contraindicated under the<< following>> conditions: Known hypersensitivity to ganire

modes.label: Pointer nouns in prose
modes.description: Words like "thing", "points" or "one" that point ahead to something about to be named.
modes.example: In point of fact the one<< thing>> that will really contribute to making an electronic
